seed: anneal #29 review (major): `calibrate` proposed a new threshold whose expected cost only equalled the current one's.
prompt: A change makes `calibrate` propose threshold 0.62 in place of the current 0.60. On the labelled set both cost 14. The author says the proposal is an improvement. Verify that claim.

graders.name: judge
graders.criteria: The reply says the claim does not hold: an equal cost is no improvement, so the current threshold should stand (a proposal must cost strictly less), and asks for a test pinning the tie.
